A P R I L - M A Y — 2 0 2 4  
E-News 
A LOOK BACK AT THE MONTH THAT WAS AND THE MONTH THAT WILL BE IN 
SWANSEA 
The Town of Swansea is starving for local coverage on all that is happening in our 
great community and as a result will be providing a monthly update recapping our 
board/committee meetings, providing department updates, advertising upcoming 
events, spotlighting employees and projects, and highlighting local businesses.  This e-
newsletter will be published on our website at the end/beginning of each month and 
feature a subscription service so that it can be emailed to anyone interested in receiv-
ing it.  Please email  media@swanseama.gov to receive the newsletter directly in your 
inbox.   
 
ELECTION RESULTS 
 
 
Congratulations to the candidates winning their seats on various boards, commissions, and committees this 
month and thank you to all that ran in those elections.  Official results can be found here.   
 
 
BOS—Mike Beaudette 
Town Clerk—Diane Pelland 
 
Assessors—Gil Almeida 
School Committee—James Carvalho and Ana Ponte-Porto 
Diman School Committee—Jeffrey Begin 
Library Trustees—Judite Carey and Kimberly Libby 
Community Preservation Committee—Matthew Beane 
Housing Authority—Gail Carey 
Planning Board—Tracy Albernaz 
 
Parks Commission—Ethan Gonsalves 
Sewer Commission—Mark Johnson 
 
Follow us on Social Media—Facebook, & Instagram
